source.profile: rigid FR-4, multilayer, 1 oz outer, green LPI mask (PCB_PWR_STACKUP_COPPER_REQUEST_REV_A)

smd_pad_to_pad_mm.rule: SMD pad to pad clearance (different nets) 0.15 mm

mask_dam_mm.rule: Soldermask bridge, 1 oz green: min. pad spacing 0.10 mm; narrower dams are not made

mask_opening_to_trace_mm.rule: Keep at least 0.09 mm between soldermask openings and neighbouring traces

stencil_area_ratio.rule: IPC-7525 area ratio >= 0.66 (stencil design guideline, not a JLC PCB rule)

order_time_dfm: separate stage: JLC/JLCDFM check of the ordered Gerbers, not replaced by this register
